positionManipulation.title: Position Manipulation
positionManipulation.description: Apps with this permission can move and resize themselves, check their position on the screen, and quit themselves.

spawnChildWindows.title: Spawn Child Windows
spawnChildWindows.description: Apps with this permission can spawn other windows with the same permissions.

fullDiskAccess.title: Full Disk Access
fullDiskAccess.description: Apps with this permission can access all the files on your user account.

cameraAccess.title: Camera Access
cameraAccess.description: Apps with this permission can access your camera.

microphoneAccess.title: Microphone Access
microphoneAccess.description: Apps with this permission can access your microphone.
